name: dsh-fact-check
description: Fact-checking and evidence-based research skill for DeepSeek Harness: it types the request first (verify / explain / causal / compare / survey / metric), confirms the direction and runs a feasibility check, then emits a report skeleton that matches the request instead of forcing every question into a true-false verdict, in Chinese or English. Verification still never trusts model memory, cross-checks independent sources across domestic and international search ecosystems, and can route three factual judgements to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill's deterministic rules when it is not.

scripts.selftest: node tools/smoke-plugin.mjs && node tools/jev-verdict.mjs selftest && node tools/route.mjs selftest && node tools/lint-skill.mjs

author: 7starsseeker
